description: Examplecorp builds scheduling software for clinics. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and run the services behind our booking platform.
descriptionPlain: Examplecorp builds scheduling software for clinics. We are hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to design and run the services behind our booking platform.

lists.content:
• Design and build APIs in Node.js and TypeScript
  • Model data in PostgreSQL and keep queries fast
  • Run services on Kubernetes with Docker and Terraform
  • Review code and mentor other engineers

• Five years of backend experience
  • Comfort with distributed systems and on-call work
  • Clear written communication

additional: Salary: €85,000 - €105,000 per year. Hybrid: two days a week in our Berlin office. Apply on our careers page.
additionalPlain: Salary: €85,000 - €105,000 per year. Hybrid: two days a week in our Berlin office. Apply on our careers page.

description: Exciting opportunity to join our dynamic, fast-paced team.
descriptionPlain: Exciting opportunity to join our dynamic, fast-paced team.

description: Lead the design of our deployment platform. You will set technical direction for how teams ship software to Kubernetes, improve our Terraform modules and make Prometheus and Grafana dashboards something every team trusts. We value written design documents and careful, boring reliability over clever tricks. You will work with product teams to find what slows them down and remove it, and you will coach engineers across the company.
